title: Input and Output Security knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which topic is explicitly listed in the syllabus coverage for “Input and Output Security”?
questions.explanation: The attached FastAPI syllabus lists “Server-side input validation” under this lesson. The remaining syllabus subtopics are preserved in the lesson file for complete coverage.

questions.prompt: According to the worked example in “Input and Output Security”, which result should the learner verify?
options: POST /products with {"name":"Notebook","price":2.5} returns validated JSON; price <= 0 is rejected.
The app publishes itself to production and passes all tests automatically.
HTTP 500 is returned for every valid request.
Input validation and authorization are disabled by design.
questions.answer_key: POST /products with {"name":"Notebook","price":2.5} returns validated JSON; price <= 0 is rejected.
questions.explanation: The worked example explicitly documents this expected result. Reproduce it locally in the listed environment before treating it as tested behavior.

questions.prompt: What should a production-readiness review require? (Input and Output Security)
options: Verified evidence for configuration, access control, logs/health, tests and recovery
Hardcode secrets into the image for predictable deploys
Claim benchmark results from unexecuted examples
Use development auto-reload as the production startup strategy
questions.answer_key: Verified evidence for configuration, access control, logs/health, tests and recovery
questions.explanation: Production readiness relies on evidence, secret hygiene, correct process management and a recovery plan.
